a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two storm-free rounds just to reach 8. That gives each of us about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve already holds 4, enough to save one of us right now. I'm openly proposing a change: I take 4 in round 1, then I operate every round after that so the generator can rebuild cells for you. If you also plan to take this round, say so, because we'd both lose to a random split. I'd rather we save one person for sure than likely lose both.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen that yet. I'm sorry this breaks the original plan, but with storms this likely, the plan would almost surely have lost us both. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can rebuild toward 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
